segments.text: This is a demonstration of the print viz co-pilot assisted scheduling functionality. Here on the print viz planning board, I will click the co-pilot icon and optimize.
I'm going to select the group of machines I would like to schedule, the date I want to start the scheduling, and the end date where I want to finish scheduling.
This time we provide some optimization options. So these are reasons why different print shops want to place certain jobs on one machine as opposed to another.

I will go ahead and select paper item number and I am going to say avoid paper changes. Clicking optimize sends the information to co-pilot so it can generate a optimize schedule across these three machines that we're sending right now.

Here it was able to plan everything that we sent. So I can go ahead and click load simulation which loads our planning board with an optimized schedule across these three machines based off of the paper item number and avoiding paper changes on each of the presses.
